about:
A Holy Order is an organization of religious devotees which exists to serve the Faith.

An Order will lease Holdings from other Rulers. They may have a Holy Order Patron who controls their Capital, and to whom they provide benefices.

There are two types of Holy Orders. Monastic Orders serve to increase Development, spread Tenets, and provide Spiritual Fulfillment. Military Orders may be hired into Holy Wars against a … or ….
